prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement across a rugged, moss-covered lava field under a cloudy sky. The camera pans slightly to the left, revealing large, dark volcanic rocks interspersed with patches of vibrant green moss, creating a stark contrast against the muted gray tones of the overcast day. As the viewer progresses, the camera angle shifts subtly upward, capturing the expansive horizon where rolling hills fade into the misty distance. The terrain is uneven, with occasional dips and rises that cause the camera to bob gently, simulating the natural gait of walking. The surrounding environment remains empty, emphasizing the solitude of the landscape. The fog thickens intermittently, momentarily obscuring distant features before thinning out again. The light is diffused, casting soft shadows and giving the scene a cool, subdued palette. Throughout the journey, the camera maintains a consistent pace, offering a continuous and immersive view of this remote, untouched Icelandic wilderness.
